audit_member_text: The module sets MPI Cartesian reorder=.true. at L78, while misc.f90 passes the MPI_COMM_WORLD rank myid to MPI_CART_COORDS and builds ProcessorID/world-rank mappings without obtaining the reordered comm2d rank. This confirms a cross-file communicator/rank-interface mismatch: any actual reorder can assign wrong coordinates, tile ranges, neighbors and point-to-point destinations.

EtaBlowVal is declared without initialization at L384. In io.f90 its READ_FLOAT is commented and an unrelated stale ierr condition controls a 10.0 assignment; CHECK_BLOWUP later always compares against EtaBlowVal. Unless another initialization routine always assigns it, the stability check can use undefined data.

Several module initializers conflict with READ_INPUT's absent-key defaults: MinDepth 0.001/MinDepthFrc 0.5/CFL 0.15/FroudeCap 10/SWE_ETA_DEP 0.7 at L149-L154 versus io.f90 assignments 0.1/0.1/0.5/3.0/0.8; DISPERSION .FALSE. at L177 versus .TRUE.; Csp 0.15 and CDsponge 0.0 at L378-L379 versus 0.1 and 5.0. The routine-level values overwrite them only after their reads, making pre-read consumers and alternate initialization paths configuration-dependent.
